page_title: RSO 1-1 GIR | Real Sociedad v Girona 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
90+2' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+1' David Lopez (Girona) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Bernardo (Girona) has replaced Arnau Martinez.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
90' The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
89' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
86' The game has come to an end for Yangel Herrera. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ivan Martin (Girona).
85' The referee shows the yellow card to Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
84' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Flag goes up against Valery (Girona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Here is a change. Benat Turrientes is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
79' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
75' The attendance is 30848.
74' Here comes a substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Mikel Oyarzabal.
74' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Hamari Traore and he is replaced by Alex Sola (Real Sociedad).
74' Takefusa Kubo will be replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Real Sociedad).
72' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Viktor Tsygankov sends a long raking pass onto the head of Artem Dovbyk (Girona), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 1:1.
70' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
68' Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a great save to deny Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
64' Substitution. Savio did his best and is replaced by Valery (Girona).
64' Michel has decided to make a change. Pablo Torre (Girona) replaces Yan Couto.
64' The substitution is prepared. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cristhian Stuani.
63' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
60' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
60' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Imanol Alguacil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replacing Carlos Fernandez.

56' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) receives a quality pass and releases a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just wide of the right post. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.
54' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
52' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francisco Maeso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
48' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
46' The whistle blows and Francisco Maeso starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) gets a yellow card.
45+3' Booking. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) receives a caution from the referee.
45+2' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
38' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' The ball is cleared after Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
34' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
33' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
30' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Handball by Yan Couto (Girona).
24' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
23' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) meets a cross inside the box, but Paulo Gazzaniga wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
20' Real Sociedad enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
16' NO PENALTY! Referee Francisco Maeso has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Real Sociedad players are incensed.
14' Celebrations by Real Sociedad are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
13' Daley Blind (Girona) jumps into a tackle and Francisco Maeso signals a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Real Sociedad is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
10' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) produces a poor free kick from the edge of the box as he sends the ball miles wide of the left post.
9' Arnau Martinez (Girona) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
8' Savio (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' 1 - 0 What a hit! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
4' One of the players from Girona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
